meta.rural_proxy_method: No published rural-by-state access rate exists in WDI or NDHS. Rural proxy = NDHS 2024 state population-with-electricity × the national rural/total ratio (27.7 ÷ 50.5 = 0.549). A state without an NDHS figure falls back to the national NDHS rural figure.
meta.caveat: "With electricity" in NDHS means the household reports an electricity connection or supply; it says nothing about hours of supply or reliability, so it overstates usable access. WDI and NDHS differ by method and year.
